sentences.text:
Mr. G.N. Rout, Asc.
 Coram:
Mr. Justice D.Dash
Mr. Justice G. Satapathy

Order
Order No. 13.11.2023
 03. 1.
This matter is taken up through hybrid arrangement  (virtual/physical) mode.

2. These eighteen (18) Petitioners by filing this writ Petition have invoked the jurisdiction of this Court under Ariticle-226 & 227 of the Constitution of India in advancing the following prayer:-
"Directing the Opposite Party Nos.3 and 4 to pay the petitioners the enhanced compensation amount along with interest as per the order of the Civil Judge (Senior Division), Berhampur in MJC No.74 of 1990 vide its order dated 03.07.1998 under Annexure-1 and the order passed by the Land Acquisition Officer, Ganjam i.e.
Opposite Party No.3 dated 20.09.1999 under Annexure-2 (Series) within a stipulated time as this Hon'ble court may deem fit and proper."
3.
Heard Mr. Sohan Mishra, learned Counsel for the Petitioners and Mr. G.R. Rout, learned Additional Standing Counsel.

4. Keeping in view the submissions made, the averments taken in the writ petition as well as the documents annexed thereto being perused; it is seen that the Petitioners banking upon the provisions contained in section 28-A of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 claiming payment of compensation for the acquisition of their // 2 // lands at the enhanced market price as has been determined in MJC No.74 of 1990 in the matter of reference under section 18 of the L.A. Act made at the instance of one Bette Babayya, whose land is said to have been acquired under the same notification.

It is stated that the Petitioners having approached the Land Acquisition Officer there had been calculation of the enhanced compensation in terms of the said award passed by the Referral Court as payable to the Petitioners, but as yet no action has been taken by the Opposite parties for payment of the said differential compensation to these Petitioners.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
The Petitioners while enclosing the order of the Land Acquisition Officer running into two pages have not filed the first page from which it could have been seen as to when the Petitioners approached the Land Acquisition Officer carrying the application under section-28(A) of the L.A.
Act, which is required to be filed within three months from the date of award of the Referral Court.
Despite the opportunities being granted on two earlier occasions for the reasons best known to them, the deficiency has not been met by the Petitioners.

6. In the above state of affairs, being in position to ascertain as to whether the move of the Petitioners under section-28(A) of the L.A. Act was within the period prescribed in law, we are inclined to dismiss this writ Petition.
No order as to cost.
Issue urgent certified copy as per rules.
(D. Dash), Judge.
